correctness.rationale: The proof first determines all path-reflection degrees by exact signed Lefschetz recurrence, then computes the full group character of the core join. The matching complex splits into that core and 2n cone attachments, each centered at one common-vertex edge. In the m=3k+2 case each link-to-core map is an integral homology isomorphism because I_{3k-1}->I_{3k} is a homotopy equivalence. The resulting equivariant exact sequence has a surjective primitive augmentation boundary; hence its kernel is exactly a twisted free integral augmentation lattice. In the other residues it gives contractibility or a rank-one integral character. Finite independent chain ranks and full-group signed Lefschetz traces agree in 1,128 cases; they are not used as proof.

value.rationale: A complete integral representation of the full automorphism group of a natural infinite family refines both an existing sphere-wedge count and an S_n-only rational character. Independent cycle reflections exhibit a nontrivial modulo-four degree dichotomy, changing rational fixed homology of reflection and full-group quotients (including a distinctive surviving class for exactly two petals). These invariants are not determined by Betti numbers, subgroup restriction, or routine normalization.
